reviews.title: Welcome to Your New Boss
reviews.comment: Just completed a build.  Use quality peripherals (Memory, M.2 Drives etc...) Got amazing benchmarks fhrough several testing sites. This setup kicks butt.  Definitely worth the upgrade.
reviews.author: Raptor227

reviews.title: Not an easy upgrade but quite fast when done
reviews.comment: Purchased to upgrade my desktop for Win11. Very glad I bought before the chip prices skyrocketed. Initial install was a real bugger, but now that it is handled the board and cpu are working well. Considerably faster than my old setup
reviews.author: Sandra E.

reviews.title: Best kit ever
reviews.comment: Amazing motherboard, bios excellent, and the WiFi is super fast, and the cpu is amazing super fast the  highest temperature I've seen it reach while playing is 52 degrees, which is incredible.
reviews.author: Felix A.

reviews.title: Buen producto
reviews.comment:
Muy buen combo, solo requirió actualizar bios, lo cual me pareció muy simple, descargar e instalar por la bios, no requiere usb externa.
Muy recomendado.
reviews.author: Javier Baquero
